audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Levels 2 through First item to Volibear, while every why-line and the packet levelChart say Darius owns Levels 1-5 and First item, with Volibear only spiking at 6.
audit.why: Volibear's lane damage before 6 depends on landing Frenzied Maul twice on the same mark; he has no tank stats yet and the 50.44% Emerald+ rate is an even lane, not a five-stage loss.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Volibear, Darius, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty says 'Overall difficulty: 7.5/10' while diffRating and the Final Matchup Rating both say 5.5/10. Spike text gives no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Three fields cannot state three difficulties. Stormbringer is 160/135/110s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the single most important number here.
audit.corrected: Difficulty aligned to 5.5/10; Stormbringer's 160s rank-1 cooldown and Thundering Smash's 12s written into the spike and cooldown text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Volibear's ultimate 'The Relentless Storm' — that is his PASSIVE. His R is Stormbringer. It also credits R with a shield and CC-immunity.
audit.why: Riot's text: The Relentless Storm (P) grants attack speed and eventually bonus magic damage to nearby enemies. Stormbringer (R) leaps to a location, slows and damages beneath him, grants bonus HEALTH, and temporarily disables nearby enemy towers — no shield. The shield belongs to Sky Splitter (E), and only if Volibear is inside his own blast radius. Frenzied Maul (5s) only heals on the second cast against the same marked target, so breaking the mark denies the heal.
audit.corrected: Ultimate renamed to Stormbringer throughout, the shield attributed to Sky Splitter with its inside-the-blast condition, the unverifiable CC-immunity claim removed, and the tower disable kept as the real dive threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal item named despite 'Anti-heal his W heal' being a listed Do.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul's second-cast heal is his sustain engine; Grievous Wounds has to be bought, not just described.
audit.corrected: Executioner's timing written into the itemization line.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Thundering Smash and Stormbringer and how disciplined your trades are.
edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Thundering Smash (Stun) and how disciplined your trade windows are.

edits.after: Step out of Sky Splitter circles — he only shields inside his own blast — and break the Frenzied Maul mark to deny the heal.
edits.before: Step out of Sky Splitter lightning circles, kite out his Frenzied Maul mark to deny his second bite heal, and drop true damage.

edits.after: Frenzied Maul is 5s but only heals on the second bite into the same mark — break the mark and he gets nothing. Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1: bait the stun, anti-heal, then outer-Q him. Don't chase past the wave.
edits.before: Voli’s W heal and Q stun fuel a strong early all-in. Bait the stun, anti-heal his W, and out-trade with outer-Q once his burst is used — the R race favours you with bleed. Don't chase past the wave into Thundering Smash (Stun).

edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash: 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, matchup-defining — he charges at you and stuns the first thing he Attacks, so it is an auto-reset, not a dash. Bait it before pulling. Volibear Sky Splitter: 16s, and he only gets the shield if he stands in his own blast. Volibear Stormbringer: 160/135/110s and it disables your tower — do not sit low under turret with it up.
edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it before pulling. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.

edits.after: Volibear: Frenzied Maul mark uptime, Stormbringer at 6 (160s at rank 1), first item. Darius: level 2-3 full trade kit, first item, and the 2-item window.
edits.before: Volibear: Thundering Smash (Stun) online, level 6, first item. Darius: level 2-3 (full trade kit), first item spike, and the 2-item side-lane window.

edits.after: He charges and stuns the first thing he Attacks. Bait it, then pull inside 12s.
edits.before: His engage. Bait it before pulling. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.after: Frenzied Maul only heals on the second bite into the same mark — walk out of the mark, buy Executioner's, and his sustain stops paying.
edits.before: Pull Volibear as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.

edits.after: Stormbringer disables your turret for its duration, so a low HP bar under tower is not safety while his 160s ult is up.
edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.

edits.after: Track Thundering Smash, 12s: he charges and stuns the first thing he Attacks. Pull only while it is down.
edits.before: Track Volibear's Thundering Smash (Stun): His engage. Bait it before pulling. Engage only while it is down.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Executioner's early — Frenzied Maul's second bite is his sustain. Core Stridebreaker, then Sterak's; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage / Dead Man's Plate; boots Plated Steelcaps.

edits.after: His R Stormbringer is the swing: a 160s leap that slows and damages beneath him, gives him bonus health, and disables your tower, so it turns a safe recall into a dive. Respect the level-6 spike; don't sit low expecting to win the exchange.
edits.before: His R The Relentless Storm makes him untargetable-jump immune to CC and grants a shield plus tower disable — it dodges your E-pull and lets him all-in or dive. Respect the level-6 power spike; don't sit low expecting to win the exchange.

edits.after: His level-6 R Stormbringer is the swing: a 160s leap that lands on you with bonus health and disables your tower, so being low under turret is no longer safe. Play tighter at 6 — but once that ult is spent, and at first item, you reclaim the brawl.
edits.before: His level-6 R The Relentless Storm is the swing: it makes him leap CC-immune, shields him, and disables your tower, letting him dodge your E-pull and all-in or dive. Play safer at 6 and don't sit low — but after the spike, at first item, you reclaim the brawl.

edits.after: Roughly even and skill-based from items on. Both of you are sustain bruisers, so fights hinge on engage and cooldown reads: your E-pull and R execute versus his Stormbringer leap and the 12s Thundering Smash. Whoever punishes the other's whiff takes it.
edits.before: Roughly even and skill-based from items on. Both of you are sustain bruisers, so fights hinge on landing engage and reading cooldowns: your E-pull and R execute versus his R leap and Q stun. Whoever commits on the other's mistake — a whiffed pull or a used stun — takes it.

edits.after: R Stormbringer to leap on you and disable the tower
edits.before: R The Relentless Storm to dodge E-pull and dive

edits.after: Land a second Maul bite to heal through the bleed
edits.before: Use R's shield and CC-immunity to flip an all-in

edits.after: You win the early exchanges. Frenzied Maul is 5s but only heals on the second bite into the same mark, so break the mark and E-pull him. He has no tank stats yet — trade whenever the 12s Thundering Smash isn't up.
edits.before: You win the early exchanges. E-pull him when his W bite is on cooldown and stack Hemorrhage with W-empowered autos — his early damage relies on hitting the W and he has no tank stats yet. Trade whenever his Q stun isn't up.

notes: REAL NAME ERROR FIXED: the content layer called Volibear's ultimate 'The Relentless Storm' in spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[1] — that is his passive; the R is Stormbringer. The same text credited R with a shield (it grants bonus health; the shield is Sky Splitter, and only if Volibear stands in his own blast) and with CC-immunity, which is not in Riot's description and I did not carry forward. breakdown.difficulty said 7.5/10 while diffRating and report[14] said 5.5/10. breakdown.wave and report[4].t carry the same spliced-in 'Key Mechanical Cooldowns / How Darius Wins Trades' corruption seen on the other Darius pages.
